app.title: Start the Shipments app
app.description: Install and start Shipments in Settings → Apps, then select Submit to find it. The custom integration must be installed and Home Assistant restarted first. Standalone installations can use the standalone service option instead.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect the Shipments app
hassio_confirm.description: Connect this app to Home Assistant? Connection credentials are exchanged privately through Supervisor. No token setup is needed.

standalone.title: Connect a standalone service
standalone.description: Enter the service origin and its integration credential. These details are needed only when the service runs outside the Home Assistant app.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect the service
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the service origin and replacement credential. Home Assistant app connections normally obtain their credentials automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Shipments service. Check that it is running and try again.
error.integration_required: Home Assistant needs an integration credential. Owner and ingestion credentials cannot connect the integration.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS origin without credentials, path, query, or fragment.
error.app_not_found: The Shipments app has not announced a connection. Install or start it, then try again.
error.supervisor_required: This Home Assistant installation does not manage apps. Connect a standalone service instead.
error.supervisor_unavailable: Cannot contact Home Assistant Supervisor. Try again after it is available.
error.multiple_apps: Several Shipments apps are available. Use the discovered integration card for the app you want.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Shipments backend can be configured.
abort.invalid_discovery: The app announced incomplete or invalid connection details. Restart or update the app and try again.
abort.already_configured: This Shipments app is already connected.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: This is a different app from the existing connection.

version_mismatch.title: Shipments app and integration versions differ
version_mismatch.description: The app is version {app_version}, and this integration is version {integration_version}. Update both Shipments components to the same release, then reload the integration.

event_stream_unavailable.title: Shipment status events are unavailable
event_stream_unavailable.description: Shipments cannot read or checkpoint its status event feed. Counts and delivery estimates still update. Check the app connection and storage, then reload the integration. The saved cursor will resume when the connection recovers.

event_history_reset.title: Shipment event history was reset
event_history_reset.description: The app has less event history than the saved Home Assistant checkpoint, usually after an app-only restore. Events now resume from the current tail to avoid replaying old shipments. Some transitions from the missing history could not be delivered. Review automations that depend on these events.
